title: Can I Tan Before or After BBL?
h1: Can I tan before and after BBL?
desc: Can you tan before or after BBL laser? Why sun, sunbeds and self-tanner should be avoided, how long to wait and how to protect your skin in Dubai.
answer: No, not around your treatment. Avoid sun tanning, sunbeds and self-tanner for at least 2 weeks before BBL, because tanned skin absorbs more light and is more likely to burn or change colour. After BBL, avoid direct sun for at least 2 weeks and wear SPF 50 daily, as treated skin can darken easily.
body:
## Why tanning and BBL don't mix

A tan is extra pigment in the skin. BBL is designed to target pigment, so a tan absorbs some of the light, increasing the risk of burns, blisters and patches of lighter or darker skin.

## Self-tanner and spray tans

Self-tanner colours the surface of the skin and can affect how the light is absorbed. Let it fully fade before treatment, and wait until the skin has settled after BBL, usually about a week, before applying it again. Ask us if you're unsure.

## Living in Dubai

With strong sun all year, plan BBL around holidays and beach trips, and protect treated skin with SPF 50, a hat and shade. Read the [BBL preparation guide](/blog/bbl-preparation-guide/) and [BBL aftercare](/blog/bbl-aftercare/).
faq: I have a light tan. Can I still have BBL?
Usually not; wait until the tan fades, often 2 to 4 weeks.
Can I go to the beach after BBL?
Avoid direct sun for at least 2 weeks after each session.
Use a dedicated SPF 50 sunscreen and reapply when outdoors.
